### NotificationSettingsView.swift
- SettingsIntro bell: 'This Mac can tell you when a thread finishes or fails while you are somewhere else. Click a notification to open its thread. Nothing alerts for the thread you are looking at, and these choices stay on this Mac.'
- SettingsCard 'Notifications': SettingsToggle 'Notify on this Mac' detail 'New finished and failed results, the ones Needs you lists. Turning this on asks macOS the first time.'; InfoRows macOS: glyph 7 + 'Allowed'/'Denied'/'Not asked' + secondary 26 'Open System Settings' / 'Ask macOS'
- SettingsCard 'Channels' note 'A channel turned off still lists its results in Needs you, without a notification.'; ChannelAlertToggle: name 13 medium + '#id' 11.5 mono fg3 + toggle; pad 16x10 surface r16; gap 8

### SecretsSettingsView.swift
- SettingsIntro lock: 'Values live in the Keychain under the service `omni-os` and are injected as environment variables when a thread runs. A channel secret overrides a global one with the same name. Omni never shows a value again after you save it; to change one, save it again with the same name.'
- SettingsCard 'Add or replace': Scope FieldBox menu picker + chevronDown 13 fg3; Name mono field 'SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN' + ghost 28 'Use HERMES_API_KEY' (key 12); Value secure mono 'Paste the value' + hint 12 fg3; primary 34 'Save' + Loader + DoneNote 'Saved'
- list: caption 'Global 3' / '#volero 2'; SecretRow pad 12x6 hover r18: key 14 fg3, name 12.5 mono fg, reltime 12 fg4, trash icon 28; error NeedsNote pl24
- confirm 'Delete X from Global?' 'Omni removes the value from the Keychain. Threads that start after this run without it.'
- empty 'No secrets yet' 'Add a token above, for example a Shopify Admin API token scoped to the client's channel.'

### SyncSettingsView.swift
- SettingsIntro refresh: 'Sync keeps this Mac's history in step with your other Mac through your own Supabase project. Each Mac keeps its own database; Supabase only relays the changes. The sign-in token lives in the Keychain, and the password is never stored.'
- Status card trailing: ghost 28 Pause/Resume, primary 28 'Sync Now'; InfoRows Status (glyph 7 + 'Up to date'), Last sync, Next try, To push '3 (1 held)', Waiting, This Mac (mono 12 + copy icon 26), Cursor fg2; footer 12 fg3 'Signing out removes the credentials from the Keychain. History stays on this Mac.' + secondary 28 'Sign Out'
- Sign in card: 'Sign in to your relay' / 'Sign in again' note 'Use the same Supabase user on each Mac. The one-time Supabase setup is in the README. Use the anon key, never the service-role key.'; NeedsNote 'The relay signed this Mac out. Sign in again to keep syncing.'; 2-col Supabase URL + Anon key (mono); Email; 'Sign in with' SegmentedPill small Password / Email code; Password; Code + ghost 32 'Send Again'; primary 34 'Sign In'
- Path map card note 'Paths travel with your home folder as ~. When the other Mac keeps a folder somewhere else, map it here: ~/work to ~/code turns its ~/work/volero into ~/code/volero on this Mac.'; rows: mono From → (arrowRight 14 fg4) To + trash icon 30; secondary 32 'Add Mapping' (plus 13) + primary 32 'Save' + DoneNote 'Saved'
